Rule.name: Test All Connectors
Rule.Description: Teste tous les connecteurs IIQ 8.4p3 et génère un rapport HTML. Usage : IIQ> rule "Test All Connectors" Rapport : /tmp/iiq_connector_report.html
Rule.Source:
import sailpoint.object.Application; import sailpoint.object.QueryOptions; import sailpoint.object.Filter; import sailpoint.connector.ConnectorFactory; import sailpoint.connector.Connector; import sailpoint.tools.GeneralException; import java.util.List; import java.util.ArrayList; import java.util.Map; import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Date; import java.text.SimpleDateFormat; import java.io.FileWriter; import java.io.BufferedWriter; // ─── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────── String reportPath = "/tmp/iiq_connector_report.html"; SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"); String runTimestamp = sdf.format(new Date()); // ─── Récupération des applications ─────────────────────────── QueryOptions qo = new QueryOptions(); qo.add(Filter.notnull("type")); qo.add(Filter.ne("type", "")); List apps = context.getObjects(Application.class, qo); // ─── Exécution des tests ───────────────────────────────────── List results = new ArrayList(); int pass = 0, fail = 0, skip = 0; System.out.println("\n[IIQ] Démarrage des tests — " + runTimestamp); for (Object obj : apps) { Application app = (Application) obj; Map row = new HashMap(); row.put("name", app.getName()); row.put("type", app.getType()); if (app.isDisabled()) { row.put("status", "SKIPPED"); row.put("reason", "Application désactivée"); row.put("elapsed", "—"); results.add(row); skip++; System.out.println(" [SKIPPED] " + app.getName()); continue; } long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis(); try { Connector c = ConnectorFactory.getConnector(app, null); if (c == null) { row.put("status", "SKIPPED"); row.put("reason", "ConnectorFactory a retourné null"); row.put("elapsed", "—"); results.add(row); skip++; System.out.println(" [SKIPPED] " + app.getName() + " — factory null"); continue; } c.testConfiguration(); long ms = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0; row.put("status", "SUCCESS"); row.put("reason", ""); row.put("elapsed", ms + " ms"); pass++; System.out.println(" [SUCCESS] " + app.getName() + " — " + ms + "ms"); } catch (Exception e) { long ms = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0; String msg = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.getClass().getName(); if (msg.length() > 200) msg = msg.substring(0, 200) + "..."; // Échapper HTML msg = msg.replace("&","&").replace("<","<").replace(">",">").replace("\"","""); row.put("status", "FAILURE"); row.put("reason", msg); row.put("elapsed", ms + " ms"); fail++; System.out.println(" [FAILURE] " + app.getName() + " — " + ms + "ms"); } results.add(row); } // ─── Génération des lignes de tableau HTML ─────────────────── StringBuilder rows = new StringBuilder(); for (Object o : results) { Map r = (Map) o; String status = (String) r.get("status"); String cssClass = "success"; String badge = "SUCCESS"; if ("FAILURE".equals(status)) { cssClass = "failure"; badge = "FAILURE"; } if ("SKIPPED".equals(status)) { cssClass = "skipped"; badge = "SKIPPED"; } rows.append("\n"); rows.append(" ").append(r.get("name")).append("\n"); rows.append(" ").append(r.get("type")).append("\n"); rows.append(" ").append(badge).append("\n"); rows.append(" ").append(r.get("elapsed")).append("\n"); rows.append(" ").append(r.get("reason")).append("\n"); rows.append("\n"); } // ─── Template HTML complet ──────────────────────────────────── String html = "\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "IIQ — Rapport Connecteurs\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "
\n" + "
\n" + "

Généré le : " + runTimestamp + "  |  SailPoint IdentityIQ 8.4p3

\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "\n" + "\n"; // ─── Écriture du fichier HTML ───────────────────────────────── BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(reportPath)); writer.write(html); writer.close(); System.out.println("\n[IIQ] Rapport HTML généré : " + reportPath); System.out.println("[IIQ] SUCCESS: " + pass + " FAILURE: " + fail + " SKIPPED: " + skip); return "Rapport écrit dans " + reportPath + " — SUCCESS:" + pass + " FAILURE:" + fail + " SKIPPED:" + skip;
